scale: fraction 0-1: HubSpot stores hs_deal_stage_probability and icalps_oppocertainty as fractions; the operator's 50 % / 75 % / 90 % are 0.5 / 0.75 / 0.9
binning: bin_index = numpy.digitize(certainty, edges) = BigQuery RANGE_BUCKET(certainty, edges): 0 below the first edge, k when edges[k-1] <= certainty < edges[k], len(edges) at or above the last edge; NULL stays NULL

hubspot_property.name: deal_tier_v1
hubspot_property.label: Deal tier (L2, likelihood)
hubspot_property.description: L2 likelihood tier from the deal's certainty (icalps_oppocertainty on Icalps, the stage probability elsewhere); edges 0.5 / 0.75 / 0.9; written daily from BigQuery deal_tiers through StackSync

unusable_properties.win_probability: mirror of hs_deal_stage_probability on SealSQ pipelines (manual edits aside)

retirement: a deal whose certainty is cleared, or that leaves the sync, keeps its gold row with tier NULL, previous_tier and retired_at; StackSync then clears deal_tier_v1
